lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹਾ ਭੋਗ ਭੂਮਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਕੋ ਧਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh samoohaa bhog bhoom sabaaee ko dhanee ||
lines.translation: Even if one were to enjoy all pleasures, and be master of the entire earth,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਭੋ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak habho rog miratak naam vihooniaa ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, all of that is just a disease. Without the Naam, he is dead. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਕਸ ਕੂੰ ਤੂ ਆਹਿ ਪਛਾਣੂ ਭੀ ਹਿਕੁ ਕਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hikas koo(n) too aahi pachhaanoo bhee hik kar ||
lines.translation: Yearn for the One Lord, and make Him your friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸੜੀ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਪਰਥਾਈ ਲਜੀਵਦੋ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aasaRee nibaahi maanukh parathaaee lajeevado ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, He alone fulfills your hopes; you should feel embarrassed, visiting other places. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਰਾਇਣੋ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nihachal ek naraaino har agam agaadhaa ||
lines.translation: The One and only Lord is eternal, imperishable, inaccessible and incomprehensible.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nihachal naam nidhaan hai jis simarat har laadhaa ||
lines.translation: The treasure of the Naam is eternal and imperishable. Meditating in remembrance on Him, the Lord is attained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵਾਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nihachal keeratan gun gobi(n)d guramukh gaavaadhaa ||
lines.translation: The Kirtan of His Praises is eternal and imperishable; the Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਤਪੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਅਰਾਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach dharam tap nihachalo din rain araadhaa ||
lines.translation: Truth, righteousness, Dharma and intense meditation are eternal and imperishable. Day and night, worship the Lord in adoration.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਤਪੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੋ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਾਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: daiaa dharam tap nihachalo jis karam likhaadhaa ||
lines.translation: Compassion, righteousness, Dharma and intense meditation are eternal and imperishable; they alone obtain these, who have such pre-ordained destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਟਲੈ ਨ ਟਲਾਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nihachal masatak lekh likhiaa so talai na talaadhaa ||
lines.translation: The inscription inscribed upon one's forehead is eternal and imperishable; it cannot be avoided by avoidance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਬਚਨ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nihachal sa(n)gat saadh jan bachan nihachal gur saadhaa ||
lines.translation: The Congregation, the Company of the Holy, and the word of the humble, are eternal and imperishable. The Holy Guru is eternal and imperishable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਰਾਧਾ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin sadaa sadaa aaraadhaa ||19||
lines.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny worship and adore the Lord, forever and ever. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok dakhane mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਡੁਬੰਦੋ ਆਪਿ ਸੋ ਤਰਾਏ ਕਿਨੑ ਖੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo duba(n)do aap so taraae kinh khe ||
lines.translation: One who himself has drowned - how can he carry anyone else across?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਰੇਦੜੋ ਭੀ ਤਾਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰ ਸਿਉ ਰਤਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taaredaRo bhee taar naanak pir siu ratiaa ||1||
lines.translation: One who is imbued with the Love of the Husband Lord - O Nanak, he himself is saved, and he saves others as well. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਕੋਇ ਕਥੰਨਿ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਣੰਦੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai koi katha(n)n naau suna(n)do maa piree ||
lines.translation: Wherever someone speaks and hears the Name of my Beloved Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂੰ ਜੁਲਾਊਂ ਤਥਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੀ ਪਸੰਦੋ ਹਰਿਓ ਥੀਓਸਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: moo(n) julaaoo(n) tath naanak piree pasa(n)do hario theeos ||2||
lines.translation: that is where I go, O Nanak, to see Him, and blossom forth in bliss. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸਨੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: meree meree kiaa karahi putr kalatr saneh ||
lines.translation: You are in love with your children and your wife; why do you keep calling them your own?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ਨਿਮੁਣੀਆਦੀ ਦੇਹ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vihooneeaa nimuneeaadee deh ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the human body has no foundation. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੈਨੀ ਦੇਖਉ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nainee dekhau gur darasano gur charanee mathaa ||
lines.translation: With my eyes, I gaze upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan; I touch my forehead to the Guru's feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਲਦਾ ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਹਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pairee maarag gur chaladaa pakhaa pheree hathaa ||
lines.translation: With my feet I walk on the Guru's Path; with my hands, I wave the fan over Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਜਪੰਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: akaal moorat ridai dhiaaidaa din rain japa(n)thaa ||
lines.translation: I meditate on Akaal Moorat, the undying form, within my heart; day and night, I meditate on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਛਡਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਅਪਾਇਣੋ ਭਰਵਾਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਮਰਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai chhadiaa sagal apaaino bharavaasai gur samarathaa ||
lines.translation: I have renounced all possessiveness, and have placed my faith in the all-powerful Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਭੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bakhasiaa naam nidhaan sabho dukh lathaa ||
lines.translation: The Guru has blessed me with the treasure of the Naam; I am rid of all sufferings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੋਗਹੁ ਭੁੰਚਹੁ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਪਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਗਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhogahu bhu(n)chahu bhaaeeho palai naam agathaa ||
lines.translation: Eat and enjoy the Naam, the Name of the indescribable Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਿੜੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam daan isanaan diR sadaa karahu gur kathaa ||
lines.translation: Confirm your faith in the Naam, charity and self-purification; chant the Guru's sermon forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਲਥਾ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj bhaiaa prabh paaiaa jam kaa bhau lathaa ||20||
lines.translation: Blessed with intuitive poise, I have found God; I am rid of the fear of the Messenger of Death. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok dakhane mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਗੜੀਆ ਪਿਰੀਅੰਨਿ ਪੇਖੰਦੀਆ ਨਾ ਤਿਪੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: lagaReeaa pireea(n)n pekha(n)deeaa naa tipeeaa ||
lines.translation: I am centered and focused on my Beloved, but I am not satisfied, even by seeing Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਭ ਮਝਾਹੂ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਬਿਆ ਨ ਡਿਠੋ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: habh majhaahoo so dhanee biaa na ditho koi ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord and Master is within all; I do not see any other. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਥੜੀਆ ਸੰਤਾਹ ਤੇ ਸੁਖਾਊ ਪੰਧੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kathaReeaa sa(n)taah te sukhaaoo pa(n)dheeaa ||
lines.translation: The sayings of the Saints are the paths of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਧੜੀਆ ਤਿੰਨਾਹ ਜਿਨਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥਾਹੜੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ladhaReeaa ti(n)naah jinaa bhaag mathaahaRai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they alone obtain them, upon whose foreheads such destiny is written. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਡੂੰਗਰਿ ਜਲਾ ਥਲਾ ਭੂਮਿ ਬਨਾ ਫਲ ਕੰਦਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: doo(n)gar jalaa thalaa bhoom banaa phal ka(n)daraa ||
lines.translation: He is totally permeating the mountains, oceans, deserts, lands, forests, orchards, caves,

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ਆਕਾਸ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਹਭ ਘਟਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: paataalaa aakaas pooran habh ghataa ||
lines.translation: the nether regions of the underworld, the Akaashic ethers of the skies, and all hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਓ ਇਕਤੁ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਤੀਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak pekh jeeo ikat soot paroteeaa ||3||
lines.translation: Nanak sees that they are all strung on the same thread. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jee maataa har jee pitaa har jeeu pratipaalak ||
lines.translation: The Dear Lord is my mother, the Dear Lord is my father; the Dear Lord cherishes and nurtures me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਬਾਲਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jee meree saar kare ham har ke baalak ||
lines.translation: The Dear Lord takes care of me; I am the child of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਖਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਆਲਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje sahaj khilaaidaa nahee karadaa aalak ||
lines.translation: Slowly and steadily, He feeds me; He never fails.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਚਿਤਾਰਦਾ ਗਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਾਇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: augan ko na chitaaradaa gal setee laaik ||
lines.translation: He does not remind me of my faults; He hugs me close in His embrace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਿ ਮੰਗਾਂ ਸੋਈ ਦੇਵਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: muhi ma(n)gaa(n) soee devadaa har pitaa sukhadaaik ||
lines.translation: Whatever I ask for, He give me; the Lord is my peace-giving father.
